Entourage__AppConfig__Meta.Meta__Description: The entourage system's defaults. A project's Entourage__SceneData is born with a full copy of these, and from then on the project's own values win. Figures are never loaded on a project that is not enabled, so nor is this file.
Entourage__AppConfig__Meta.Meta__WhySameKeys: The keys of Entourage__LineRules__Config, Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config and Entourage__PlaceDefaults__Config are exactly the keys in a project's record, so a default is one grep from where it is saved.

Entourage__SceneData__Config.Entourage__SceneData__Description: What a project's object starts with. ShowByDefault and DefaultTransparencyPercent are where a viewer starts on a device that has not chosen.
Entourage__SceneData__Config.Entourage__SceneData__EnabledByDefaultNo: On for every project unless an admin has unticked it in Dev Tools (Adam, 05-Nov-2026: 'make the admin ticked on boxes on by default now ... keep those gates so i can disable though'). Only a saved Enabled false turns a project off.
Entourage__SceneData__Config.Entourage__SceneData__DefaultTransparenc: Adam, 05-Nov-2026: "Default face transparency should be 60%". Line and face fade together, as Garnett's plants do: his choice of treatment C on the look test.

Entourage__LineRules__Config.Entourage__LineRules__Description: The Entourage Linework panel's sliders. Weights are screen pixels, as RenderConfig__Linework__LineWidth is. They start at what Garnett's plants were tuned to, the look Adam asked these to match: "the plants on that look amazing, so human entourage needs to be in the same flavour and vibe".

Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Descriptio: The panel's Advanced dropdown: how an outline becomes a drawn line.
Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__CornerDegN: A turn sharper than this, measured over CornerSpanMm either side, stays a corner when the outline is smoothed.
Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__PenLiftEve: About how far along the outline the pen lifts, each one drawn from the figure's seed. The Pen lifts slider divides this: 2.00 is twice as many.
Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__HookNotchD: A notch at least this sharp, an armpit or between the legs, may carry its line on inward as a short hook, as a plant's line does at a cusp.
Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__FillWallSh: A figure's fill against the model's walls: 1.00 is exactly the brightness of a wall facing the camera, worked out from the scene's lights for each view, as a plant's is.
Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__FillToneNo: The fill on a sheet, where a figure lies on paper and has no walls to match.
Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__Config.Entourage__LineRulesAdvanced__DepthBiasN: Log depth, as a plant's, so a figure's lines sit on its own fill and the model's 15 cm at 150 m does not reach the figure in front.

Entourage__PlaceDefaults__Config.Entourage__Place__Description: The asset browser: the next figure dropped from a card.

Entourage__Transparency__Config.Entourage__Transparency__Description: The Transparency slider. At 0 nothing changes: the same opaque route as if it did not exist.
Entourage__Transparency__Config.Entourage__Transparency__SeeThroughFromP: From here a figure stops masking the profile lines of what is behind it, so the wall's edges show through.

Entourage__DevTools__Config.Entourage__DevTools__Description: The Dev section, the asset browser and moving figures about.
Entourage__DevTools__Config.Entourage__DevTools__WarnAboveFiguresNot: Every figure is in the project's file, and other apps read that file. Past this the Dev section says so.
Entourage__DevTools__Config.Entourage__DevTools__DragThresholdPxNote: NPR's: a card moved less than this was a click, which arms it for the next click on the model.
Entourage__DevTools__Config.Entourage__DevTools__RightClickSlopPxNot: A right press that travelled further was a pan, so it opens no menu.
Entourage__DevTools__Config.Entourage__DevTools__MaxPlaceSlopeDegNot: A figure lands only on what faces up at least this much, so a drag over a wall keeps it on the last good spot.
Entourage__DevTools__Config.Entourage__DevTools__JamesificationNote: Adam, 11-Nov-2026: a second slider, Jamesification, that stretches a figure's height only, 1 to 1.50. Saved as Entourage__Figure__HeightStretch, on top of Entourage__Figure__Scale; exactly 1 is not saved.

Entourage__Ring__Config.Entourage__Ring__Description: What shows under a figure being interacted with, from NPR's footprint: AssetDrop__ShowMarker. It is on a 2D canvas over the model, so it can never print.
Entourage__Ring__Config.Entourage__Ring__MinRadiusMmNote: Half the figure's width, or this if that is less.

Entourage__Generators__Config.Entourage__Generators__Description: What can draw a figure, by name and version. A saved seed must draw the same figure for ever, so a generator is never edited once a project can hold its figures: a new look is a new version, and the old one stays. The build util refuses an asset naming one not listed here.

Entourage__Generators__List.Generator__Note: One flat figure turned to the camera. A Silhouette's outline is smoothed and takes pen lifts and hooks from the seed; a LineDrawing keeps its lines and takes pen lifts on its outline. Na__Entourage__FigureBuilder__.js
